params.message:
A new newsletter can start from an outline for KUBO or for Afrodidact

Each edition is read by very different people: donors, technical readers, schools and
partners, funds. An outline gives each of them a part: a story from a school, how it
works, what it achieved and what readers can do, with a button to support. Hints to
replace stand in square brackets, and the editor lists any left so none goes out.
